title: Six years after final safety orders, San Francisco General faced new citations

beats.text: A workplace safety case at San Francisco General reached final orders in 2020.

visual.sub: A previous City inspection reached final orders

beats.text: The earlier penalties totaled $26,660. One serious item accounted for $25,000.

visual.label: A previous City inspection reached final orders

beats.text: In December 2025, a university social worker died after an assault at the City hospital.

visual.kicker: Two employers faced separate assessments after one incident

beats.text: This time, the state proposed $130,500 against the hospital.

visual.label: Two employers faced separate assessments after one incident

beats.text: The University of California Regents separately faced $142,700.
Both employers contested the citations. The federal files record September 15, 2026.
The City also raised the hospital guard contract ceiling by $3.2 million.

visual.label: Two allowances lay behind the larger guard contract

beats.text: The budget analyst questioned an extra allowance on top of the contingency.
All 89 paid vouchers match the guard contract register to the cent.

visual.label: An annual commitment and a contract with 89 paid vouchers

beats.text: The health department separately committed $15 million annually across its entire system.

visual.kicker: An annual commitment and a contract with 89 paid vouchers

beats.text: Those records show what the City paid. They leave the final penalties unresolved.
